summary: Iteration 3 testing for Rurapp — Image upload bug fix + Admin discount codes + Redemption flow. Ran 21 new backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py + 6 UI flows via Playwright. Backend: 21/21 passed (100%). Frontend: all 7 checked flows pass (branding, producer login, image uploader UI, base64 preview render, product card renders base64 image with naturalWidth>0, redeem-code card visible for producer, admin creates RURA- code and it appears in table). Also re-seeded backend once because campesino user's membership_active had been flipped by earlier iterations (future-dated expires_at but active=false). No new bugs found. Regression checks (start-trial one-time, membership checkout stripe/wompi/mercadopago) all still pass.

minor.issue: Rejects images <100 bytes with generic 'Archivo vacío o inválido'. Very small solid-color PNGs (~85 bytes) trip this. Not user-facing under normal conditions but the threshold could be lowered to say 20 bytes, or the check dropped in favor of trusting PIL to reject truly malformed input.

5 MB limit is checked on RAW upload bytes, not on the resulting base64 string. Since data URLs are ~1.37x larger, a 5 MB upload could store a ~6.7 MB image_url in Mongo. Product documents may cross the 16 MB BSON limit if a user uploads many large images to one product. Consider storing at max ~2 MB output or moving to object storage before scale.

campesino@rurapp.co seed user was found with membership_active=false but membership_expires_at in the future. Not reproducible from a fresh seed — appears to be state left over from previous iteration tests that toggled membership. Re-seed fixes it. Consider making seed idempotent-refresh on every run OR guarding against inconsistent state (active=false but expires_at in future) in the status endpoint.

issues: Table is dense with many prior test rows (23 rows visible during test). Consider pagination or filter (active/inactive) for admin UX at scale.

action_items: None blocking — all core requirements verified working. Optional: consider bounding the size of the stored base64 data URL (compress harder or clamp longest side to 800px) since 5 MB uploads inflate to ~7 MB after base64.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py adds CORSMiddleware + logging.basicConfig TWICE (lines 1369-1394). The second block is dead / duplicate — remove.
/api/uploads/image imports PIL, base64, io INSIDE the request handler. Move to module top-level for perf.

Base64 storage in Mongo: works for MVP but every product read now hauls the full image bytes over the wire on /api/products (500-doc list). Marketplace scroll will get slow. Consider a separate collection or thumbnail field.

DiscountCode.uses field is $inc'd on redeem but the max_uses check is done BEFORE the increment without a transaction — a race between two simultaneous redeems could overshoot max_uses. Low likelihood at scale, but note it.
server.py is now 1400+ lines. Split into routers/ (auth, products, services, orders, bookings, memberships, admin, uploads).

MembershipCheckoutRequest is reused for /memberships/start-trial and /memberships/redeem-code path is a separate model — the trial route requires origin_url even though it doesn't use it. Cleaner to have a StartTrialRequest with only plan_id.
